items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled OUT vs Jaguars; also Pitre OUT.
items.implication: Full backfield to Marks or committee; Marks previously 98% snaps in Monty's absence.
items.opportunity: Woody Marks elevated to lead role/RB2 upside in London game.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is OUT for Sunday vs Panthers after follow-up ultrasound showed movement in a superficial blood clot in his calf; health priority as treatment course determined. Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Blood clot movement from prior cleat injury; possible blood thinners preventing play.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense downgraded, rush attack and red-zone impacted without dual-threat QB.
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume potential for Goedert/Smith/Wicks if McKee airs it out; reverse any prior Hurts beneficiaries.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return due to shoulder, then returned to the TNF game.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.
items.implication: Full participation restored; no lingering for next week assumed.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle this week on volume/matchup.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice for second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.why: Shoulder; consecutive DNPs raise Week 6 risk.
items.implication: Questionable or worse for Sunday vs Raiders; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Other Bills WRs elevated if OUT.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 6; backup opportunity if limited/OUT.
items.opportunity: Other ARI RBs if Love sidelined.

items.text: No practice again for Saquon Barkley; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice.
items.why: Barkley continued absence (hamstring/stinger context); Smith toe upgrade.
items.implication: Barkley high risk OUT/Q; Smith trending toward play. With Hurts OUT, Eagles run game fragile.
items.opportunity: Gainwell or other backs if Barkley out; Goedert already elevated.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again due to hamstring.
items.implication: Week 6 status in doubt; Worthy/others upside.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again.
items.implication: Realistic chance but trending limited/OUT risk vs Falcons.
items.opportunity: Ravens backup QB and Likely/Henry usage shifts.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week out (high ankle); Rhamondre Stevenson saw 85% snaps/23 touches in prior absence, averaging 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches.
items.why: Henderson high ankle multi-week; Stevenson prior full workload.
items.implication: Stevenson clear lead back/RB1-2 for multiple weeks.

items.text: With Breece Hall week-to-week/no practice: RB snaps in two full games since injury - Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0.
items.why: Clear lead role to Allen in Hall absence.
items.implication: Allen is the primary handcuff/start if Hall out.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen heavy snap share and RB1/2 upside.

items.text: On Saquon Barkley situation/age and Eagles trade precedent: worth risk of moving a year too early than too late; agrees in this case.
items.why: Age curve and team history of moving early on stars.
items.implication: Sell-high window even amid injury; long-term value risk.
items.opportunity: Trade Saquon for younger assets before further decline.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons.
items.implication: Cleared path to start; Bears offense stable.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks him WR4 for Week 6 on matchup and elevated target share with Samuel out.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers; Evans 36% target share recently, higher without Deebo.
items.implication: Must-start WR1 upside in favorable spot.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28); low volume outside one outlier game, tough matchup.
items.why: 204 yards season, 67% in one game; averaging 16.5 otherwise; SEA tough.
items.conflict: Returned ACTIVE mid-TNF but volume concerns persist.
